sloka: अभिक्रुद्धः समर्थो हि चापम् उद्यम्य राघवः ।स देव असुर गंधर्वम् वशे स्थापयितुम् जगत् ॥४-३२-१९॥
transliteration: abhikruddhaḥ samartho hi cāpam udyamya rāghavaḥ ।sa deva asura gaṁdharvam vaśe sthāpayitum jagat ॥4-32-19॥

translations.english: If enraged, Rama, raising his bow, is able to bring the whole world—including gods, demons and gandharvas—under his control.
